origin.description: MATCH.times matches chron times after trunc to the requested units. Values within one unit after truncation share a match. NA matches NA.
origin.usage: MATCH.times(x, table, nomatch = NA, units = "sec", eps = 1e-10, ...)

arguments.name: table
arguments.text: chron times values to match against.

arguments.name: nomatch
arguments.text: Returned when there is no match. It is coerced to integer.

arguments.name: units
arguments.text: Passed to trunc.times. Seconds, minutes, hours, and days are supported for time-of-day values.

origin.details: MATCH.times calls match on trunc(x, units, eps) and trunc(table, units, eps). A value matches any table entry that truncates to the same fraction of a day.
origin.value: An integer vector of the first matching positions.
origin.example:
library(chron)
x <- c(times("12:34:56.5"), times("12:34:57.4"), times("12:35:00"), NA, times("00:00:01"))
t <- c(times("12:34:56"), times("12:35:00"), times("00:00:01"), NA)
print(MATCH.times(x, t))
print(MATCH.times(x, t, nomatch = 0))

translation.description: MATCH.times matches chron times after trunc to the requested units. Values within one unit after truncation share a match. NA matches NA.
translation.usage: MATCH.times(x, table, nomatch = NA, units = "sec", eps = 1e-10, ...)

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: Times values from zoo.times.times or any object marked as chron times.

arguments.name: nomatch
arguments.text: Returned when there is no match. It is coerced to integer.

arguments.name: units
arguments.text: Truncation unit: sec, min, hour, or day, with chron-style name prefixes.

arguments.name: eps
arguments.text: Added before flooring, as in trunc.times.
Further arguments passed to match, including incomparables.

translation.details: MATCH.times calls match on trunc(x, units, eps) and trunc(table, units, eps). Parsing h:m:s strings uses the same second counts as chron times.
translation.value: A list of one-based positions, with None where nothing matched.
translation.example:
from zoo.match import MATCH_times
from zoo.times import times

x = times(["12:34:56.5", "12:34:57.4", "12:35:00", "00:00:01"])
t = times(["12:34:56", "12:35:00", "00:00:01"])
# append NA like c(..., NA) in R by passing float('nan') in a Times vector
import math
from zoo.times import Times
x = Times(list(x) + [float('nan')])
t = Times(list(t) + [float('nan')])
print(" ".join("NA" if v is None else str(v) for v in MATCH_times(x, t)))
print(" ".join("NA" if v is None else str(v) for v in MATCH_times(x, t, nomatch=0)))
